commands.meaning: This metadata invocation with no target-cpu override; not historical R24 effective flags.

commands.meaning: This metadata invocation only; no source input, object, build or benchmark.

commands.condition: Only if present at this exact sysroot path; absent records unavailable without installation.
commands.name: llvm-profdata-version

environment_scope: Only explicit subprocess environment; no read/dump of inherited environment, HOME, SSH_AUTH_SOCK, credentials, user Cargo config or process cmdlines; no persistent environment/configuration mutation.

failure_behavior.cleanup_scope: Original directly invoked Popen child only, not a process-group/global absence certificate.
failure_behavior.nonzero_timeout_output_limit_incomplete_: Keep every saved byte, record error and false pass, exit1; capped/incomplete streams are never described as complete.
failure_behavior.output_directory_bootstrap_failure: Do not overwrite or create an alternative attempt; emit the failure report as bounded native stderr JSON and exit1.
failure_behavior.report_write_failure: Emit a bounded report-write error to stderr and exit1.

future_compiler_experiment_note: Later builds may explicitly remove CARGO_PROFILE_*, CARGO_TARGET_*, CARGO_BUILD_* and RUSTC/RUSTFLAGS-related overrides. This probe does not mutate existing build configuration and never implies old releases had such overrides cleared.
not_performed: current or historical Cargo flag reconstruction
purpose: Metadata only for assessing a later accepted-R24-source compiler-only experiment. This does not qualify/select a variant or reconstruct historical effective flags.
saved_metadata: current-process sched_getaffinity and logical CPU count
output-volume available/total bytes and available inodes
known R24 receipt/source-map/runtime and Cargo identities, no source contents
repository .cargo/config and .cargo/config.toml existence/bytes/SHA only, no contents
selected rustc and optional profdata identities
each actual command argv/status/timing/owned-child PID and reap result
complete bounded stdout/stderr as new files plus hash
report.json; native-only cfg lines are descriptive metadata
source_verification_scope: Checks the bound220 source inputs and named optional repository configs only. It does not attest all possible future Cargo auto-discovery/global config inputs. A later build requires its own exact-source/environment/command receipt.

toolchain.discovery: One fixed sysroot and direct rustc/profdata paths only; missing rustc fails, no fallback toolchain or rustup shim.
toolchain.llvm_profdata_version_scope: Record returned version and whether it reports LLVM22.1.2; absence or version discovery is not PGO qualification.
